name: Mind Engraving
descriptionTemplate: After using {Keyflare Rouse}, consume an additional [Arg1] Keyflare, reducing the Arithmetica Cost of the received {Rouse} card to 0. Upon playing, the corresponding Awakener gains an additional [Arg2] Aliemus.
lore: The ancient tribe believed that engraving special symbols on the skulls of the dead could keep their souls for eternal companionship.

variants.name: Mind Engraving
variants.label: Faded Legacy - Cursed
variants.descriptionTemplate: Increase hand limit by 3, but draw 1 less card each turn. Discard all Symptom Cards and State Cards at turn end, keeping other cards.
variants.lore: The ancient tribe believed that engraving special symbols on the skulls of the dead could keep their souls for eternal companionship.

variants.name: Blessed: Mind Engraving
variants.label: Faded Legacy - Blessed
variants.descriptionTemplate: Increase hand limit by 5 and replenish hand to the limit At battle start. Draw 1 extra card at turn start, and discard all Symptom Cards and State Cards at turn end while keeping other cards.
variants.lore: The greedy carve their mistakes into their hearts and dedicate themselves to atoning for their past.

variants.name: Sinful: Mind Engraving
variants.label: Faded Legacy - Sinful
variants.descriptionTemplate: Increase Hand Limit by 5 and draw 6 cards At battle start. At turn end, discard all Symptom Cards and State Cards in hand, keeping other cards, but draw 2 fewer cards each turn.
variants.lore: The greedy treat others as objects, deriving pleasure from others' suffering.
